headline: Koufonikolakou: Honest governance, fair development, productive reconstruction are the pillars of ELAS’s plan
summary: Theoni Koufonikolakou said ELAS's economic plan, to be presented by Alexis Tsipras at the Thessaloniki International Fair, centres on tackling high prices, strengthening incomes and fighting corruption.
why: Economic policy proposals from political parties can signal future fiscal and regulatory direction, which matters for investors in Greek assets.
